name: prompt-master
description: Evidence-first task mastery with inter-skill orchestration, structured clarification controls, and automatic heavy-task execution.

interface.longDescription: Abhar Mastery is an evidence-first task-mastery plugin with coordinated specialist skills. Prompt Master is the primary orchestrator; Prompt Validation checks actionable prompts, inputs, data, and outputs, and collects essential missing details through labeled text inputs and appropriate choice controls when the active host supports them. Compact forms group multiple independent required fields when useful. Checkboxes are for multi-select; radio buttons or single-select dropdowns are for mutually exclusive choices. The system checks conversation and supplied files before asking, minimizes personal-data collection, validates entered values against known rules, and resumes the task. If interactive controls are unavailable, it uses a plain-text fill-in template without claiming it is interactive. For genuinely Heavy tasks, Adaptive Execution defaults to Automatic Intelligence Execution; Controlled and Hybrid remain available on explicit request. Relevant file-ingestion, Evidence Standards, Critical Audit, and Humanizer workflows are coordinated in the correct order. Runtime Test Protocol separates static package checks, live host behavior, and directly observed invocation traces. Implicit invocation is enabled where supported, but host routing, account eligibility, product availability, safety controls, and tool access remain platform-controlled. This is a Skills-only package with no hosted backend, background worker, or persistent project database.
capabilities: Always-on task mastery and prompt expansion
Inter-skill orchestration with Prompt Master as coordinator
Explicit Controlled and Hybrid execution modes
Capacity-aware prompt optimization and staged delivery
Automatic prose humanization with fact preservation
Structured clarification with labeled text inputs
Checkboxes for multi-select and radio/select for single-choice
Field validation, data minimization, and plain-text fallback
defaultPrompt: Apply Abhar Mastery: validate, coordinate skills, execute, verify, and refine prose.
If essential details are missing, use labeled text inputs and the right choice controls when supported.
For heavy work, use Automatic execution by default and validate every stage.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.4.3: added Structured Clarification UI Protocol. Essential exact details use labeled text inputs when supported; compact forms group multiple independent required fields; checkboxes support multi-select and radio/select controls enforce one-of-many choices. Added field validation, data minimization, plain-text fallback, and test coverage. Retains v1.4.2 orchestration and Automatic heavy-task default.
